4.name: Show Me the Way to Go Home
4.overview: Alice is about to graduate high school; Kat and Elliot dream of the next steps for their relationship; Del realizes she will soon be an empty-nester again.

4.name: Blinded by the Light
4.overview: When Kat finds herself in a new era of Port Haven history, new mysteries unfold. Meanwhile, Alice revisits a familiar time, and Del tries to help Elliot. Stars Andie MacDowell, Chyler Leigh, Evan Williams, Sadie Laflamme-Snow.

4.name: Dust in the Wind
4.overview: Kat and Elliot plan a romantic getaway, while Alice tries to gather more clues. Del and Sam get a surprise visit from Elliot's father, Vic.

4.name: We've Got Tonight
4.overview: When Nick arrives back in Port Haven, Del throws a party like old times. Alice has to keep her distance from Young Colton and Del, but tries to learn more.

4.name: Don't Cry Out Loud
4.overview: When Nick joins Kat on her search for more information about Elliot's mother in the 1920s, the two realize they may be in over their heads.

4.name: Yes Sir, That's My Baby
4.overview: Elliot becomes engrossed with uncovering more of his mother's secret history and recruits Kat's help, while Jacob reacclimatizes to life in Port Haven.

4.name: Working My Way Back to You
4.overview: Some questions are answered for Elliot and Kat, while others linger. New choices arise for Alice as she evaluates her future.

4.name: Tainted Love
4.overview: As Kat works to piece together what lies ahead, Elliot tries to learn more about Tessa as he does his best to reconnect with his mom.

4.name: Auld Lang Syne
4.overview: New Year's Eve in 1925 brings into focus the Landry and Augustine families' destiny, and Elliot and Kat witness it. In another time, Alice does the same.

4.name: Ahead By a Century
4.overview: Across generations, endings and new beginnings arrive for the Landry family and their loved ones, as the pond always brings surprises.

overview: سه نسل از زنان قوی و مستقل که با هم در شهر مزرعه ای کوچک پورت هیون زندگی می کنند، سفری روشنگر را آغاز می کنند که هیچ یک از آنها نمی توانستند تصورش را هم بکنند، زیرا یاد می گیرند چگونه راه خود را به سمت یکدیگر پیدا کنند.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season two starts where season one left off, with Kat Landry exclaiming to her mom Del that she knows what happened to Jacob Landry. As Kat continues her quest to find Jacob and bring him home, mother and daughter uncover unexpected revelations about their origins that bring answers to some questions while new ones are raised.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: New journeys and revelations await the Landry family across generations. At the beginning of season 4, Alice is about to graduate high school, Kat and Elliot dream of the next steps for their relationship, while Del realizes she will soon be an empty-nester again. But Del, Kat, Alice and Elliot should know by now that no matter how hard they try to focus on the future, the past is never gone. As more mysteries are unearthed, the Port Haven of the past and the Landry family of generations before might just contain the answers they seek.

tagline: Every past ends in the present.
title: The Way Home
